parts.name: Long rose marble support shaft
parts.description: Tall narrow faceted rose/ivory shaft, delicate vertical white engaged columns and small gold foot/head leaves. The lower source shaft is largely plain stone between columns, not giant blue windows. Extend only the flower-obscured bottom to a modest flat attachment face.

parts.name: Floral belt and relief neck
parts.description: Shallow ivory/gold collar belt at shaft head with pale white floral relief panels on rose marble and closely spaced gold trim. Preserve source little brackets and profile changes; do not invent a broad balcony.

parts.name: Small arched lookout drum
parts.description: Short narrow gallery drum with small blue lancets, slim ivory columns, gold leaf springers, delicate white/gold sill balustrade. No giant windows and no added second gallery floor.

parts.name: Compact plum onion canopy
parts.description: Compact violet onion crown with slender gold meridians and a tall delicate multi-knop gold spindle/star. Keep a modest overhang relative to the narrow drum, pointed rising shoulder; not the broad western pavilion bulb.

No whole wall, tower, roof or assembled staircase in this detail pack. Individual objects shown at readable independent review scales; full depth, mounting backs and clean seam ends. Source motifs remain consistent with their parent structural sections. Preserve exact printed IDs and short item names, no extra objects or duplicate alternate views. Thin profile parts have sensible complete ends. Avoid detached ornaments fused to each other. Common lantern cages/pendants already exist in PAL-TOWER-001-D14/D15/D16; only family-specific mounts/junctions are requested here.
STRICT SHAPE QUALITY: use restrained simple technical product views with nearly frontal orthographic geometry. Straight columns remain straight, arches regular, curved strips smooth and single. No melted curls, warped faces, gratuitous spikes or asymmetric duplicated leaves. Do not thicken delicate parts to giant ornaments. A roof rib is only ONE thin curved gold strip, no roof panels or whole cone. Each fitting is isolated, complete, and evenly separated from its label. Caption every cell with the exact full ID AND short name.
prompts.decor_correction: Correct only the faulty cells of this 16-item belvedere detail sheet. Keep all IDs/names, 4-by-4 grid, palette and all other parts unchanged. D07 Faceted belt cornice and D08 Belt corner return are SOURCE MOULDED STONE BANDS, not small window walls: DELETE every miniature pointed arch and every blue glazed inset from these two pieces. Show smooth ivory/rose veined marble bands with three fine horizontal mouldings and thin gold lips; D07 one short faceted strip, D08 its matching clean mitred corner. No extra flowers or windows on these two bands. D12 Curved gallery balustrade is an OPEN pierced ivory/gold low railing: remove the blue infill panels from between its tiny arches; leave clean see-through voids and thin supports, no blue glass. D02 Pilaster foot leaf is a tiny restrained gold leaf clamp for an ivory shaft foot, remove the oversized rectangular wall corbel and large scroll. Source shape quality: regular smooth edges, straight shafts, complete ends, delicate gold rather than bloated or melting ornaments. All sixteen objects remain single isolated components with unchanged exact full captions.
